title: implement log_forward

atoms.evidence: out = Tensor(array, requires_grad) — wraps the np.log output array into the custom Tensor class with requires_grad flag
out.recipe = Recipe(func=np.log, args=(x.array,), kwargs={}, parents={0: x}) — constructs the (func, args, kwargs, parents) dataclass
requires_grad = grad_tracking_enabled and x.requires_grad — the AND-over-flags pattern (here for a single-arg fn)
Test cell explicitly toggles: grad_tracking_enabled = False; b = log_forward(a); assert not b.requires_grad — the module-level bool gate
parents={0: x} — single-entry dict keyed by arg-index 0 (since log takes one Tensor input)
Solution structure: compute array → build Tensor(array, requires_grad) → if requires_grad, attach Recipe — the canonical box-and-attach pattern

notes: 6 atoms — under seed prediction of 7 (1 less: unbox-args-tensor-to-array isn't really exercised here since np.log only takes one Tensor, accessed via x.array directly). First exercise to construct a Recipe; the foundation that wrap_forward_fn (0_4_7) generalizes.
